Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units from activities joined to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures, filtered by assay CHEMBL4649972 with exact measurements (standard_relation '=' and standard_value not null). Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
